$comment: Packages provider source may import (C-DEP-1). Node builtins (node:*) and the framework are always allowed. Each entry states why; vendor API SDKs are not accepted, providers use fetch against the documented HTTP API.

packages.@oclif/core: Command, Flags, and Args for command classes
packages.jsforce: Salesforce SDK, grandfathered for the native Salesforce provider; migration to a fetch client is follow-on work (plan section 2)
packages.jsonwebtoken: RS256 assertion signing for the DocuSign JWT Grant flow; node:crypto covers HS256 elsewhere
packages.marked: Markdown to HTML for DocuSign envelope documents authored as Markdown
